name: support_triage
description: Route an inbound support message: team, urgency, frustration, refund intent. English example — the model is most accurate in English.

team.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

criteria.shipping: Delivery status, lost or damaged parcels

urgent.instructions: This message needs a human response today

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the customer appear?

wants_refund.instructions: The customer is explicitly asking for money back

guards.why: Refund intent always gets a human — routing automation must not answer money questions on its own

notes: English is the model's primary training language; for CJK workloads test on your own data first
Ask one decision per question and keep them atomic — do not fold 'which team' and 'is it urgent' into one question
Keep prior_contacts short: unrelated detail both inflates false confidence and dilutes real confidence
